title: Bug: QoS buffer port selection can use a different DUT than the selected test DUT
author: pdam-arista
body:
Area: sonic-mgmt / QoS
Platform: generic
Severity: Medium

## Summary

The QoS buffer tests select the DUT with `rand_one_dut_hostname`, but the
module-scoped autouse `port_to_test` fixture uses the implicit `duthost`
fixture when selecting the test port and reading minigraph facts.

In a multi-DUT topology, port metadata can therefore come from a different
DUT than the DUT selected by the test.

## Affected test

`qos/test_buffer.py`

## Steps to reproduce

1. Run `qos/test_buffer.py` on a multi-DUT topology.
2. Compare the DUT selected by the test with the DUT used by `port_to_test`.
3. Observe that the test body uses `duthosts[rand_one_dut_hostname]`, while
   `port_to_test` uses implicit `duthost`.

## Actual behavior

`port_to_test` may use a different DUT from the selected test DUT.

## Expected behavior

`port_to_test` should resolve the DUT with
`duthosts[rand_one_dut_hostname]` before reading port metadata.

## Before-fix evidence

The dualtor execution showed suite hosts `gd377` and `ldp203` while the
executed testcases were parameterized for `gd426` and `ldp205`.

[Download before-fix QoS buffer logs](https://github.com/pdam-arista/sonic-mgmt/releases/download/qos-buffer-selected-dut-202605-20260923/qos_buffer_before_fix_logs.zip)

### Approach

#### What is the motivation for this PR?

In multi-DUT topologies, the implicit `duthost` fixture used by `port_to_test`
can refer to a different DUT from the one selected by the test.

#### How did you do it?

Use `duthosts[rand_one_dut_hostname]` in `port_to_test` before reading
minigraph facts and selecting a test port.

#### How did you verify/test it?

The complete QoS buffer module was tested on the requested 202605 `dtAA`
testbed and completed with 2 passed and 21 skipped tests, with no test errors.
